**In one line**: OpenAI and Anthropic reportedly absorb about 80% of the venture funding going to the top "AI 50" startups.

### Key points
- Per the report, roughly 80% of venture capital directed at the AI 50 cohort is concentrated in OpenAI and Anthropic.
- The number of enterprise-ready AI startups is growing, yet the largest checks skew toward a handful of frontrunners.
- Remaining companies are said to share a comparatively small slice of the funding.

### Why it matters
When capital clusters around a few foundation-model leaders, fundraising and competition grow harder for later entrants. It signals a market tilting toward a winner-concentrated phase.
